entries.title: Archiving a shared article keeps it public
entries.body: Archiving an article you share no longer takes it off the public library: it stays on the public list for as long as it is shared, and archiving only moves it out of your way. If you used archiving to take an article off the public list, stop sharing it instead. When you add an article's address, you may also be offered someone else's public copy even if its owner has archived it.

entries.title: Digest sections are easier to tell apart
entries.body: The sections of a Sources digest are separated by a line, with more space between them and darker headings. For digests made from today, the AI is also asked to keep citations that check out away from the list of ones worth checking. Digest is behind the Experimental features switch on your profile page.

entries.title: Digest asks the AI for more questions
entries.body: A Sources digest could stop with an error when the AI suggested too few questions to search for. The AI is asked for more of them, especially for pieces that cite few sources, and if it still returns too few, the message says so plainly. Digest is behind the Experimental features switch on your profile page.
